verses.original: קֹ֔רַח בֶּן־ יִצְהָ֥ר בֶּן־ קְהָ֖ת בֶּן־ לֵוִ֑י בְּנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵֽן׃ וְדָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם בְּנֵ֧י אֱלִיאָ֛ב וְא֥וֹן בֶּן־ פֶּ֖לֶת וַיִּקַּ֣ח
verses.transliteration: qō·raḥ ben- yiṣ·hār ben- qə·hāṯ ben- lê·wî bə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên wə·ḏā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ wə·’ō·wn ben- pe·leṯ way·yiq·qaḥ
verses.literal: Now Korah son of Izhar the son of Kohath son of Levi vvv along with some Reubenites Dathan and Abiram sons of Eliab and On son of Peleth conducted

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֙מוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם אַנְשֵׁי־ וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים מִבְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵֽׁם׃ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י עֵדָ֛ה קְרִאֵ֥י מוֹעֵ֖ד
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū lip̄·nê mō·šeh ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯā·yim ’an·šê- wa·’ă·nā·šîm mib·bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl šêm nə·śî·’ê ‘ê·ḏāh qə·ri·’ê mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: a rebellion against Moses along with 250 . . . men . . . vvv of Israel renowned as leaders of the congregation and representatives in the assembly

verses.original: וַיִּֽקָּהֲל֞וּ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶם֮ רַב־ לָכֶם֒ כִּ֤י כָל־ כֻּלָּ֣ם הָֽעֵדָה֙ קְדֹשִׁ֔ים יְהוָ֑ה וּבְתוֹכָ֖ם וּמַדּ֥וּעַ תִּֽתְנַשְּׂא֖וּ עַל־ קְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·hă·lū ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·hem raḇ- lā·ḵem kî ḵāl kul·lām hā·‘ê·ḏāh qə·ḏō·šîm Yah·weh ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām ū·mad·dū·a‘ tiṯ·naś·śə·’ū ‘al- qə·hal Yah·weh
verses.literal: They came together against Moses and Aaron and told them . . . [You have taken] too much upon yourselves For everyone in the entire congregation is holy and the LORD is in their midst Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע וַיִּפֹּ֖ל עַל־ פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yiš·ma‘ way·yip·pōl ‘al- pā·nāw
verses.literal: When Moses heard this he fell facedown . . .

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ קֹ֜רַח וְאֶֽל־ כָּל־ עֲדָתוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בֹּ֠קֶר יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ וְיֹדַ֨ע אֲשֶׁר־ ל֛וֹ וְאֶת־ הַקָּד֖וֹשׁ וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֵלָ֑יו וְאֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַר־ בּ֖וֹ יַקְרִ֥יב אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’el- qō·raḥ wə·’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏā·ṯōw lê·mōr bō·qer Yah·weh ’eṯ- wə·yō·ḏa‘ ’ă·šer- lōw wə·’eṯ- haq·qā·ḏō·wōš wə·hiq·rîḇ ’ê·lāw wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥar- bōw yaq·rîḇ ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Then he said to Korah . . . and all his followers . . . Tomorrow morning the LORD - will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy and He will bring that person near to Himself - The one He chooses He will bring near to Himself

verses.original: קֹ֖רַח וְכָל־ עֲדָתֽוֹ׃ עֲשׂ֑וּ זֹ֖את קְחוּ־ לָכֶ֣ם מַחְתּ֔וֹת
verses.transliteration: qō·raḥ wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏā·ṯōw ‘ă·śū zōṯ qə·ḥū- lā·ḵem maḥ·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: [You,] Korah and all your followers are to do as follows Take censers

verses.original: מָחָ֔ר וּתְנ֣וּ אֵ֡שׁ קְטֹ֜רֶת עֲלֵיהֶ֨ן בָהֵ֣ן׀ וְשִׂימוּ֩ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה יִבְחַ֥ר וְהָיָ֗ה ה֣וּא הַקָּד֑וֹשׁ בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃ רַב־ לָכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: mā·ḥār ū·ṯə·nū ’êš qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘ă·lê·hen ḇā·hên wə·śî·mū lip̄·nê Yah·weh hā·’îš ’ă·šer- Yah·weh yiḇ·ḥar wə·hā·yāh hū haq·qā·ḏō·wōš bə·nê lê·wî raḇ- lā·ḵem
verses.literal: and tomorrow you are to place fire and incense - in them - in the presence of the LORD Then the man - the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy It is you sons of Levi who have taken too much upon yourselves

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ קֹ֑רַח נָ֖א שִׁמְעוּ־ בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- qō·raḥ nā šim·‘ū- bə·nê lê·wî
verses.literal: Moses also said to Korah Now listen you sons of Levi

verses.original: הַמְעַ֣ט מִכֶּ֗ם כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶתְכֶם֙ הִבְדִּיל֩ מֵעֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהַקְרִ֥יב אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑יו לַעֲבֹ֗ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַת֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁכַּ֣ן וְלַעֲמֹ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לְשָׁרְתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ham·‘aṭ mik·kem kî- ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ·ḵem hiḇ·dîl mê·‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·haq·rîḇ ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lāw la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ Yah·weh miš·kan wə·la·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh lə·šā·rə·ṯām
verses.literal: Is it not enough for you that the God of Israel - has separated you from the congregation of Israel and brought you near - to Himself to perform - the work at the LORD’s tabernacle and to stand before the congregation to minister to them

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֹֽתְךָ֔ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אַחֶ֥יךָ אִתָּ֑ךְ בְנֵי־ לֵוִ֖י וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֖ם כְּהֻנָּֽה׃ גַּם־
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rêḇ ’ō·ṯə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’a·ḥe·ḵā ’it·tāḵ ḇə·nê- lê·wî ū·ḇiq·qaš·tem kə·hun·nāh gam-
verses.literal: He has brought you near - - [you] and all your fellow - Levites . . . but you are seeking the priesthood as well

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ עֲדָ֣תְךָ֔ הַנֹּעָדִ֖ים עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן מַה־ ה֔וּא כִּ֥י תִלּוֹנוּ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏā·ṯə·ḵā han·nō·‘ā·ḏîm ‘al- Yah·weh wə·’a·hă·rōn mah- hū kî ṯil·lō·nū ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Therefore it is you and all your followers who have conspired against the LORD As for Aaron who is he that you should grumble against him

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח לִקְרֹ֛א לְדָתָ֥ן וְלַאֲבִירָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yiš·laḥ liq·rō lə·ḏā·ṯān wə·la·’ă·ḇî·rām bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ way·yō·mə·rū lō na·‘ă·leh
verses.literal: Then Moses summoned . . . Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab but they said We will not come

verses.original: הַמְעַ֗ט כִּ֤י הֶֽעֱלִיתָ֙נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ לַהֲמִיתֵ֖נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי־ גַּם־ תִשְׂתָּרֵ֥ר הִשְׂתָּרֵֽר׃ עָלֵ֖ינוּ
verses.transliteration: ham·‘aṭ kî he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯā·nū mê·’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš la·hă·mî·ṯê·nū bam·miḏ·bār kî- gam- ṯiś·tā·rêr hiś·tā·rêr ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: Is it not enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness . . . Must you also appoint yourself as ruler . . . over us

verses.original: אַ֡ף לֹ֣א הֲבִ֣יאֹתָ֔נוּ אֶל־ אֶרֶץ֩ זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֤ב וּדְבַשׁ֙ וַתִּ֨תֶּן־ לָ֔נוּ נַחֲלַ֖ת שָׂדֶ֣ה וָכָ֑רֶם תְּנַקֵּ֖ר הַעֵינֵ֞י הָהֵ֛ם הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ lō hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯā·nū ’el- ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš wat·tit·ten- lā·nū na·ḥă·laṯ śā·ḏeh wā·ḵā·rem tə·naq·qêr ha·‘ê·nê hā·hêm hā·’ă·nā·šîm lō na·‘ă·leh
verses.literal: Moreover you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards Will you gouge out the eyes of these men No, we will not come

verses.original: לְמֹשֶׁה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיִּ֤חַר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה אַל־ תֵּ֖פֶן אֶל־ מִנְחָתָ֑ם לֹ֠א נָשָׂ֔אתִי וְלֹ֥א אֶחָ֤ד חֲמ֨וֹר מֵהֶם֙ הֲרֵעֹ֖תִי אֶת־ אַחַ֥ד מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mō·šeh mə·’ōḏ way·yi·ḥar way·yō·mer ’el- Yah·weh ’al- tê·p̄en ’el- min·ḥā·ṯām lō nā·śā·ṯî wə·lō ’e·ḥāḏ ḥă·mō·wr mê·hem hă·rê·‘ō·ṯî ’eṯ- ’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem
verses.literal: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD Do not regard . . . their offering I have not taken . . . one donkey from them or mistreated - a single one of them

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ קֹ֔רַח אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ עֲדָ֣תְךָ֔ הֱי֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מָחָֽר׃ אַתָּ֥ה וָהֵ֛ם וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- qō·raḥ ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏā·ṯə·ḵā hĕ·yū lip̄·nê Yah·weh mā·ḥār ’at·tāh wā·hêm wə·’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: And Moses said to Korah You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow you and they and Aaron

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ וּקְח֣וּ׀ מַחְתָּת֗וֹ וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם קְטֹ֔רֶת עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֞ם אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתַ֖יִם מַחְתֹּ֑ת וְאַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן אִ֥ישׁ מַחְתָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ū·qə·ḥū maḥ·tā·ṯōw ū·nə·ṯat·tem qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘ă·lê·hem wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’îš maḥ·tā·ṯōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯa·yim maḥ·tōṯ wə·’at·tāh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’îš maḥ·tā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Each man is to take his censer place incense in it and present - [it] before the LORD 250 . . . censers You and Aaron . . . are to present your censers as well

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ וַיִּקְח֞וּ מַחְתָּת֗וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ אֵ֔שׁ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וַֽיַּעַמְד֗וּ וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד
verses.transliteration: ’îš way·yiq·ḥū maḥ·tā·ṯōw way·yit·tə·nū ’êš ‘ă·lê·hem way·yā·śî·mū qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘ă·lê·hem way·ya·‘am·ḏū ū·mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: So each man took his censer put fire - - and incense in it and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: קֹ֙רַח֙ אֶת־ וַיַּקְהֵ֨ל כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֵּרָ֥א אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: qō·raḥ ’eṯ- way·yaq·hêl kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh ‘ă·lê·hem ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh way·yê·rā ’el- kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: When Korah - had gathered his whole assembly against them at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting the glory of the LORD appeared to the whole congregation

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .

verses.original: הִבָּ֣דְל֔וּ מִתּ֖וֹךְ הַזֹּ֑את הָעֵדָ֣ה וַאַכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם כְּרָֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: hib·bā·ḏə·lū mit·tō·wḵ haz·zōṯ hā·‘ê·ḏāh wa·ʾa·ḵal·lɛh ’ō·ṯām kə·rā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: Separate yourselves from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant

verses.original: וַיִּפְּל֤וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶם֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֕ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָרוּחֹ֖ת לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר אֶחָד֙ הָאִ֤ישׁ יֶחֱטָ֔א תִּקְצֹֽף׃פ וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem way·yō·mə·rū ’êl ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rū·ḥōṯ lə·ḵāl bā·śār ’e·ḥāḏ hā·’îš ye·ḥĕ·ṭā tiq·ṣōp̄ wə·‘al kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown . . . and said O God the God of the spirits of all flesh when one man sins will You be angry with the whole congregation

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵֽעָלוּ֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב לְמִשְׁכַּן־ קֹ֖רַח דָּתָ֥ן וַאֲבִירָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lê·mōr hê·‘ā·lū mis·sā·ḇîḇ lə·miš·kan- qō·raḥ dā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām
verses.literal: Tell . . . the congregation . . . to move away from the dwellings of Korah Dathan and Abiram

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיָּ֣קָם וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ דָּתָ֣ן וַאֲבִירָ֑ם זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ אַחֲרָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’el- dā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram and the elders of Israel followed him

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ הָעֵדָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר ס֣וּרוּ נָ֡א מֵעַל֩ אָהֳלֵ֨י הָאֵ֔לֶּה הָֽרְשָׁעִים֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְאַֽל־ תִּגְּע֖וּ בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם פֶּן־ תִּסָּפ֖וּ בְּכָל־ חַטֹּאתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lê·mōr sū·rū nā mê·‘al ’ā·ho·lê hā·’êl·leh hā·rə·šā·‘îm hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·’al- tig·gə·‘ū bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer lā·hem pen- tis·sā·p̄ū bə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām
verses.literal: And he warned . . . the congregation . . . Move away now from the tents of these wicked men Do not touch anything that belongs to them or you will be swept away because of all their sins

verses.original: וַיֵּעָל֗וּ מֵעַ֧ל מִשְׁכַּן־ קֹ֛רֶח דָּתָ֥ן וַאֲבִירָ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב וְדָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם יָצְא֣וּ נִצָּבִ֗ים פֶּ֚תַח אָֽהֳלֵיהֶ֔ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם וְטַפָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·‘ā·lū mê·‘al miš·kan- qō·rɛḥ dā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḏā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām yā·ṣə·’ū niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm pe·ṯaḥ ’ā·ho·lê·hem ū·nə·šê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem wə·ṭap·pām
verses.literal: So they moved away from the dwellings of Korah Dathan and Abiram Meanwhile Dathan and Abiram had come out and stood at the entrances to their tents with their wives and children and infants

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֒ וַיֹּאמֶר֮ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֔נִי לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֖ים כִּי־ לֹ֖א מִלִּבִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer bə·zōṯ tê·ḏə·‘ūn kî- Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’êṯ kāl- hā·’êl·leh ham·ma·‘ă·śîm kî- lō mil·lib·bî
verses.literal: Then Moses said This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do - all these things for it was not my own doing

verses.original: אִם־ אֵ֔לֶּה יְמֻת֣וּן כְּמ֤וֹת כָּל־ הָֽאָדָם֙ יִפָּקֵ֖ד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וּפְקֻדַּת֙ כָּל־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א שְׁלָחָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’êl·leh yə·mu·ṯūn kə·mō·wṯ kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām yip·pā·qêḏ ‘ă·lê·hem ū·p̄ə·qud·daṯ kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām Yah·weh lō šə·lā·ḥā·nî
verses.literal: If these men die a natural death - - or if they suffer . . . the fate of all men then the LORD has not sent me

verses.original: וְאִם־ יְהוָ֗ה יִבְרָ֣א בְּרִיאָ֞ה הָאֲדָמָ֤ה אֶת־ וּפָצְתָ֨ה פִּ֙יהָ֙ וּבָלְעָ֤ה אֹתָם֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֔ם וְיָרְד֥וּ חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֧י הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים נִֽאֲצ֛וּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- Yah·weh yiḇ·rā bə·rî·’āh hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’eṯ- ū·p̄ā·ṣə·ṯāh pî·hā ū·ḇā·lə·‘āh ’ō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer lā·hem wə·yā·rə·ḏū ḥay·yîm šə·’ō·lāh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî hā·’êl·leh ’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ni·’ă·ṣū Yah·weh
verses.literal: But if the LORD brings about something unprecedented and the earth - opens its mouth and swallows them and all that belongs to them so that they go down alive into Sheol then you will know that these - men have treated the LORD {with contempt}

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כְּכַלֹּת֔וֹ לְדַבֵּ֕ר אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֲדָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּחְתֵּיהֶֽם׃ וַתִּבָּקַ֥ע
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw lə·ḏab·bêr ’êṯ kāl- hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer taḥ·tê·hem wat·tib·bā·qa‘
verses.literal: - As soon as [Moses] had finished saying - all this . . . the ground - beneath them split open

verses.original: הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־ וַתִּפְתַּ֤ח פִּ֔יהָ וַתִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֖ם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ לְקֹ֔רַח וְאֵ֖ת הָאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּל־ הָרֲכֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- wat·tip̄·taḥ pî·hā wat·tiḇ·la‘ ’ō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- bāt·tê·hem wə·’êṯ kāl- lə·qō·raḥ wə·’êṯ hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer kāl- hā·ră·ḵūš
verses.literal: and the earth - opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households - all Korah’s - men - and all their possessions

verses.original: הֵ֣ם וַיֵּ֨רְד֜וּ חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָהֶ֛ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתְּכַ֤ס עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וַיֹּאבְד֖וּ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hêm way·yê·rə·ḏū ḥay·yîm šə·’ō·lāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer lā·hem hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tə·ḵas ‘ă·lê·hem way·yō·ḇə·ḏū mit·tō·wḵ haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: They went down alive into Sheol with all they owned The earth closed over them and they vanished from the assembly

verses.original: לְקֹלָ֑ם וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם נָ֣סוּ כִּ֣י אָֽמְר֔וּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ פֶּן־ תִּבְלָעֵ֖נוּ
verses.transliteration: lə·qō·lām wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·hem nā·sū kî ’ā·mə·rū hā·’ā·reṣ pen- tiḇ·lā·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: At their cries all the people of Israel who [were] around them fled - saying The earth may swallow us too

verses.original: וְאֵ֥שׁ יָצְאָ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַתֹּ֗אכַל אֵ֣ת הַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּמָאתַ֙יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ מַקְרִיבֵ֖י הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’êš yā·ṣə·’āh mê·’êṯ Yah·weh wat·tō·ḵal ’êṯ ha·ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯa·yim ’îš maq·rî·ḇê haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ
verses.literal: And fire came forth - from the LORD and consumed - the 250 . . . men who were offering the incense

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: אֱמֹ֨ר אֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְיָרֵ֤ם אֶת־ הַמַּחְתֹּת֙ מִבֵּ֣ין הַשְּׂרֵפָ֔ה וְאֶת־ זְרֵה־ הָאֵ֖שׁ הָ֑לְאָה כִּ֖י קָדֵֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·yā·rêm ’eṯ- ham·maḥ·tōṯ mib·bên haś·śə·rê·p̄āh wə·’eṯ- zə·rêh- hā·’êš hā·lə·’āh kî qā·ḏê·šū
verses.literal: Tell . . . Eleazar son of Aaron the priest to remove - the censers from the flames and to scatter the coals far away because [the censers] are holy

verses.original: אֵ֡ת מַחְתּוֹת֩ הָאֵ֜לֶּה הַֽחַטָּאִ֨ים בְּנַפְשֹׁתָ֗ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ אֹתָ֜ם רִקֻּעֵ֤י פַחִים֙ צִפּ֣וּי לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כִּֽי־ הִקְרִיבֻ֥ם לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּקְדָּ֑שׁוּ וְיִֽהְי֥וּ לְא֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ maḥ·tō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh ha·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm bə·nap̄·šō·ṯām wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·ṯām riq·qu·‘ê p̄a·ḥîm ṣip·pui lam·miz·bê·aḥ kî- hiq·rî·ḇum lip̄·nê- Yah·weh way·yiq·dā·šū wə·yih·yū lə·’ō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: - As for the censers of those who sinned at the cost of their own lives vvv vvv hammer them into sheets to overlay the altar for these were presented before the LORD and so have become holy They will serve as a sign to the Israelites . . .

verses.original: אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת וַיִּקַּ֞ח הַנְּחֹ֔שֶׁת מַחְתּ֣וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְרִ֖יבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִ֑ים וַֽיְרַקְּע֖וּם צִפּ֥וּי לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ’êṯ way·yiq·qaḥ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ maḥ·tō·wṯ ’ă·šer hiq·rî·ḇū haś·śə·ru·p̄îm way·raq·qə·‘ūm ṣip·pui lam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Eleazar the priest - took the bronze censers - brought by those who had been burned up and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ דִּבֶּ֧ר בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֽוֹ׃ זִכָּר֞וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ֠מַעַן לֹֽא־ זָ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ אֲ֠שֶׁר ה֔וּא לֹ֣א מִזֶּ֤רַע אַהֲרֹן֙ יִקְרַ֜ב לְהַקְטִ֥יר קְטֹ֖רֶת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֛ה יִהְיֶ֤ה כְקֹ֙רַח֙ וְכַ֣עֲדָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer Yah·weh wə·lō- dib·ber bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh lōw zik·kā·rō·wn liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ma·‘an lō- zār ’îš ’ă·šer hū lō miz·ze·ra‘ ’a·hă·rōn yiq·raḇ lə·haq·ṭîr qə·ṭō·reṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh yih·yeh ḵə·qō·raḥ wə·ḵa·‘ă·ḏā·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer
verses.literal: just as the LORD . . . commanded him through Moses This was to be a reminder to the Israelites . . . that no outsider . . . who is not a descendant of Aaron should approach to offer incense before the LORD lest he become like Korah and his followers -

verses.original: מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּלֹּ֜נוּ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֥ם הֲמִתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ עַ֥ם
verses.transliteration: mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·yil·lō·nū ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr ’at·tem hă·mit·tem ’eṯ- Yah·weh ‘am
verses.literal: The next day the whole congregation . . . of Israel grumbled against Moses . . . and Aaron saying You have killed - the LORD’s people

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י הָֽעֵדָה֙ בְּהִקָּהֵ֤ל עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה הֶעָנָ֑ן כִסָּ֖הוּ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה׃ וַיֵּרָ֖א
verses.transliteration: way·hî hā·‘ê·ḏāh bə·hiq·qā·hêl ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn way·yip̄·nū ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hin·nêh he·‘ā·nān ḵis·sā·hū kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh way·yê·rā
verses.literal: But when the congregation gathered against them Moses . . . and Aaron turned toward the Tent of Meeting . . . and suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the LORD appeared

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֤א אֶל־ פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn way·yā·ḇō ’el- pə·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: and the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: הֵרֹ֗מּוּ מִתּוֹךְ֙ הַזֹּ֔את הָעֵדָ֣ה וַאֲכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם כְּרָ֑גַע וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hê·rōm·mū mit·tō·wḵ haz·zōṯ hā·‘ê·ḏāh wa·’ă·ḵal·leh ’ō·ṯām kə·rā·ḡa‘ way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Get away from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant And [Moses and Aaron] fell facedown . . .

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֣ח אֶת־ הַ֠מַּחְתָּה וְתֶן־ אֵ֜שׁ עָלֶ֨יהָ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וְשִׂ֣ים מֵעַ֤ל קְטֹ֔רֶת וְהוֹלֵ֧ךְ מְהֵרָ֛ה אֶל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה וְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ הַקֶּ֛צֶף יָצָ֥א מִלִּפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הַנָּֽגֶף׃ הֵחֵ֥ל
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ ’eṯ- ham·maḥ·tāh wə·ṯen- ’êš ‘ā·le·hā ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·śîm mê·‘al qə·ṭō·reṯ wə·hō·w·lêḵ mə·hê·rāh ’el- hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·hem kî- haq·qe·ṣep̄ yā·ṣā mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh han·nā·ḡep̄ hê·ḥêl
verses.literal: Moses said to Aaron Take - your censer place fire from the altar . . . in it and add incense Go quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them because wrath has come out from the LORD the plague has begun

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֜ן וַיִּקַּ֨ח כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ מֹשֶׁ֗ה דִּבֶּ֣ר וַיָּ֙רָץ֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹך הַקָּהָ֔ל וְהִנֵּ֛ה הַנֶּ֖גֶף הֵחֵ֥ל בָּעָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶֽת־ הַקְּטֹ֔רֶת וַיְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn way·yiq·qaḥ ka·’ă·šer mō·šeh dib·ber way·yā·rāṣ ’el- tōḵ haq·qā·hāl wə·hin·nêh han·ne·ḡep̄ hê·ḥêl bā·‘ām way·yit·tên ’eṯ- haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ way·ḵap·pêr ‘al- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: So Aaron took [the censer] as Moses had ordered and ran into the midst of the assembly . . . And seeing that the plague had begun among the people . . . - he offered the incense and made atonement for the people

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד בֵּֽין־ וּבֵ֣ין הַֽחַיִּ֑ים הַמֵּתִ֖ים הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃ וַתֵּעָצַ֖ר
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ bên- ū·ḇên ha·ḥay·yîm ham·mê·ṯîm ham·mag·gê·p̄āh wat·tê·‘ā·ṣar
verses.literal: He stood between . . . the living and the dead and the plague was halted

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֗וּ הַמֵּתִים֙ בַּמַּגֵּפָ֔ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת מִלְּבַ֥ד הַמֵּתִ֖ים עַל־ דְּבַר־ קֹֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ham·mê·ṯîm bam·mag·gê·p̄āh ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ mil·lə·ḇaḏ ham·mê·ṯîm ‘al- də·ḇar- qō·raḥ
verses.literal: - But those who died from the plague numbered 14,700 . . . . . . . . . . . . in addition to those who had died on account of Korah

verses.original: אַהֲרֹן֙ וַיָּ֤שָׁב אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה נֶעֱצָֽרָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn way·yā·šāḇ ’el- mō·šeh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·ham·mag·gê·p̄āh ne·‘ĕ·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting since the plague had been halted
